# Python set up

Before starting the course, we need to install the course materials
and all dependency packages (such as SpikeInerface) onto your machine.

To do this we will create an isolated environment in which to install packages,
either using [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (recommended)
or [conda](https://docs.conda.io/). 

## Download the repository

First, clone the course repository with `git`:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/neuroinformatics-unit/course-ephys-osss.git
cd course-ephys-osss
```

If you don't have `git` installed, you can instead download the repository as a
ZIP file from the [GitHub page](https://github.com/neuroinformatics-unit/course-ephys-osss)
(click the green **Code** button, then **Download ZIP**) and unzip it.

## Create the environment

::: {.panel-tabset}

## uv

[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) is a fast Python package and environment manager.
If you don't have it yet, follow the [installation instructions](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/).

From inside the `course-ephys-osss` folder, create a virtual environment and install
the project (along with all its dependencies):

```bash
uv venv
uv pip install -e .
```

`uv venv` creates a `.venv` folder in the repository. To activate it:

```bash
# macOS / Linux
source .venv/bin/activate

# Windows (PowerShell)
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
```

## conda

[conda](https://docs.conda.io/) is a widely used Python environment and package manager.
If you don't have it yet, we recommend installing
[Miniconda](https://docs.conda.io/en/latest/miniconda.html).

From inside the `course-ephys-osss` folder, create and activate a new environment:

```bash
conda create -n course-ephys python=3.12 -y
conda activate course-ephys
```

Then install the project (along with all its dependencies) using `pip`:

```bash
pip install -e .
```

:::

## Check the installation

With the environment active, check that the package imports correctly:

```bash
python -c "import course_ephys_osss; print('Setup complete!')"
```

If this runs without error, you're ready to start the course.
